author: Krono III
title: Arch Ablation 1: Single-Step ConvLSTM
abstract: This is the first experiment in my architectural ablation study of DoubleStepSynergyNet. I hypothesize that the second ConvLSTM step is a critical component for performance. This experiment tests a modified architecture, SingleStepSynergyNet, which uses only one ConvLSTM step. The result will quantify the importance of the double-step recurrence. I am using the validated optimal mistake_penalty of 1.0.
